data.name: Mahinder
data.gender_notes: Mahinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahindra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Mahadeva, the god of mountains and thunder. This powerful name evokes strength, courage, and protection. It is believed that Mahindra bestows his bearer with the qualities of a great leader, a courageous warrior, and a wise sage. The name Mahinder carries the meaning “God of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahinder usually hope their child will grow to embody god of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power of the universe and the strength to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Mahinder belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahinder total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Mahinder is a popular name among the Hindu community, particularly in India and Nepal, and is associated with courage, bravery, and grace.
data.spiritual_significance: Mahinder is believed to be a spiritual name that represents the divine qualities of courage, wisdom, and strength, which are attributed to Mahadev, the Hindu deity. It is said that the name Mahinder not only brought blessings of physical strength but also imparts spiritual wisdom and emotional balance. Therefore, it is a highly revered name among Hindus.
